## Further reading {#sec-further-reading}

- @velleman2019prove
  is a structured introduction to proof techniques
  such as direct proof, [proof by contradiction](notation.qmd#def-proof-by-contradiction), and induction.
- @barkerplummer2011language
  treats proofs as formal derivations in propositional and first-order logic.
